optimizer: AdamW lr.005 eps1e-5 betas(.9,.999) weight_decay.01; OneCycleLR total_steps1000; no grad clip; inherited EMA.995 copies current through step1000
inference: four fixed latent-only requests; paired CPU generator noise banks in original initial/reverse/epsilon order; all training before inference
numeric_outcome_policy: Recorded FloatingPointError sampling failures are numerical diagnostic outcomes; COMPLETE_WITH_NUMERICAL_FAILURES can exit0. Timeouts and other execution errors are INCOMPLETE/FAILED exit2; never imply finite success.
interpretation: only 20 vs1000 on same trajectory, representation, seed, horizon1000; not an exact recreation of old horizon20 smoke, not sequence quality or general VAE stability
